text:
Lina Wu: Noticing a spike of 502s from customers using SDK 4.7 with model-binding enabled after today's runtime rollout. Errors point to signature mismatch when resolving pinned model aliases. Suggest a temporary SDK pin (downgrade allowed versions) for affected tenant cohort while we patch the resolver. Thoughts?
Devon Park: Can you paste one of the stack traces and which tenants are hitting it?
Lina Wu: Happening for tenants: acme-inc, beta-slate, and several smaller ones. Stack snippet: 
```
2026-03-05T11:03:12Z tenant=acme-inc request_id=xyz123 level=error http=502 resolver: model_alias_resolve failed: signature_mismatch expected=(v2) got=(v3)
Trace: at resolve_alias (/srv/runtime/alias_resolver.go:142)
```
Omar R.: Hmm. Runtime change switched alias signature to include kernel flags; SDK 4.7 still sends old-style alias tokens. We can either patch runtime to accept both, or pin SDK surface for those customers. Runtime patch ETA ~4h.
Devon Park: For minimal customer impact I'd prefer scoping a client-side version gate so requests from SDK>=4.7 for those tenants get routed to a shim runtime that accepts old tokens. Can we do a targeted runtime pin to runtime-3.2.0-shim for those tenants?
Lina Wu: Yes. Deploybot supports twin pins by tenant. If we do that, we avoid blocking global rollout.
release-coordinator-bot: Proposed command: `/pin runtime runtime-3.2.0-shim scope=tenants:acme-inc,beta-slate reason="sdk-alias-signature-mismatch" ttl=14400 initiated_by=@Lina Wu`
Devon Park: Add TTL 4h, and enable canary 1% on other tenants so we detect any unexpected fallout. Also open a rollback window in case shim misbehaves.
deploybot: Pin command received. Applying scoped pin...
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-9731 scope=tenants:[acme-inc,beta-slate] runtime=3.2.0-shim ttl=14400s initiated_by=Lina Wu. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-9731 hours=1`
SRE Pager: Alerting: suppressing downstream noise for tenant errors, but keep a high-severity channel to eng-runtime. PagerDuty on-call notified.
Omar R.: I'll start the alias-resolver backwards-compat patch now and aim for a small-binary rollbackless fix. Posting PR link when ready.
Lina Wu: Release notes/update for customers: "Temporary tenant-scoped runtime pin for acme-inc and beta-slate due to SDK alias token mismatch (PIN-9731)." Please add to release-notes and send CS a short blurb.
Devon Park: Also adding a telemetry check: count of signature_mismatch errors and 502 rate per tenant every 5m. If the error rate drops below threshold for 20m we can remove the pin early.
deploybot: Monitoring: Pin will auto-unpin after TTL unless extended. Event will be posted to #release-ops on unpin.
release-coordinator-bot: Change window opened 11:15-15:15 UTC for potential rollback/patch deployment.
Lina Wu: PR posted: https://git.redwood/runtime/PRs/5489 - patch accepts legacy alias tokens and normalizes kernel flags. Requesting quick review from Omar and Devon.
Omar R.: Reviewing now, small comment about tests. If CI green, schedule hotfix deploy to canary and then promote.
Devon Park: Thanks. Once hotfix is live in canary and we see no regressions, we plan to remove PIN-9731 and let tenants pick up runtime-3.2.1 default.
Lina Wu: Notifying CS and Solutions: short customer-facing note drafted.
SRE Pager: Monitoring rules added. I'll post telemetry snapshots every 10m here during the window.
Devon Park: :thumbsup: keeping this tenant-scoped to limit blast radius. If any other tenant surfaces the issue, escalate here immediately.
